issue.title: Daily release train for bob-cli (CI, package hygiene, release-plz rehearsal, docs)
issue.description: bob-cli has hermetic per-push CI on Linux and macOS and a renamed, trimmed package under the crates.io size cap. A scheduled release-plz train releases at most once per New York day, only after full CI passes on the exact SHA, and runs in git_only rehearsal mode (tags and GitHub Releases), ready to switch to crates.io. The process is documented on the docs site in the Diátaxis structure, and Bryan gets a report of the manual go-live steps that only he can take.
